body: Read the verdict with: aida review verdict TASK-1782. No BUG-2148 regression, and CI is green. Blocking: 'recycled' currently includes INCONCLUSIVE comparisons (unparseable pid_start, unreadable live start, cross-scheme), so a possibly-live agent is reported gone and the user is pointed at 'aida agent gc', which won't reap it (gc uses the lenient check). Recycled must be !process_identity_is_alive(pid, Some(start)) on an alive pid; everything else (None, inconclusive, pid<=1) is unknown. Add a pid_start='garbage' live-sleep test. Non-blocking: a ~5s trap wait, the dup pid-list helper, and a corrupt-entry message for pid<=1 instead of 'kill pid 1'. Mail REWORK READY.
subject: #2681 TASK-1782: CHANGES round 1 (one blocking)
